blocks.text: New supporting character for the Era Zero song cycle.

Keshet is a DBA person working in the Listening Alcove of one of the Garden Worlds. Their work is practical hospitality: arrange a chair, adjust a light with permission, remember which visitors asked for quiet.
They are not a restoration authority. They study the House of Returning as an ethical precedent and perform Room to Restore when a visitor wants a steady sound. Their voice is low and reedlike.
Sova sometimes helps prepare the surrounding garden for visitors. Their relationship is an ordinary working friendship, not evidence of a shared origin or a later surviving lineage.
